title: Preserve every inventory rule
prompt: Implement the book’s inventory contract: positive unique id, nonempty name, quantity from 0 to 1000, and at most 100 records. Rejected adds return false and leave every record unchanged. total returns a long long sum; successful records keep insertion order.
signature: class Inventory: bool add(Record); long long total() const; const std::vector<Record>& records() const

tests.label: Positive id required
tests.hint: Identifiers must be greater than zero.

tests.label: Zero accepted and insertion order
tests.hint: Zero is allowed; accepted records append in call order.

hints: Validate every input rule before pushing to the vector.
The size limit is 100; search existing records for the id.
explanation: The book separates Record and Inventory into a header and implementation. This single-file lab tests that same contract. The class owns its vector; every rejection preserves it unchanged.
chapterTitle: Building a Complete Multi-File C++ Application
